title: Denver Police Officer Shoots Armed Man While Investigating Fireworks Complaint
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Denver, Colorado  — On July 1st, 2025, around 9:03 p.m., two Denver Police Officers approached a group of individuals gathered outside a home in the 4300 block of North Del Rio Court. What began as a routine response to illegal fireworks turned critical when one man walked away toward a garage, prompting commands from officers that were ignored. According to police, the man appeared to reach toward his waistband, leading an officer to fire two shots, striking him in the leg. A loaded 10mm Glock was later recovered nearby, though the footage does not clearly show the man holding or drawing the weapon. The man survived and was transported to a local hospital. He has not been charged and was not identified. The officer who fired the shots, a department veteran since 2019, has not been publicly named and is currently in Denver’s reintegration program, which follows any use of force.
